product.name: PosTooChat Message Center
product.purpose: Author, validate, publish and export conversational messages, actions and media for Telegram and WhatsApp.

architecture.media_store: R2 for images, videos and PDFs
architecture.video_delivery: Direct HTTPS assets initially; Cloudflare Stream may be introduced for transcoding or protected playback.
architecture.source_of_truth: The D1 catalog managed only by this Worker API.
architecture.legacy_role: The legacy Python application and messages.json are import-only migration sources and are never a second live authoring path.

binding.content_sid_env: Twilio Content SID environment-variable name, or empty when unbound

assets.url: https://published asset URL or Worker-served R2 URL

invariants: A message name and numeric ID are unique within the catalog.
A channel override is always saved explicitly under overrides.telegram or overrides.whatsapp; it never mutates default implicitly.

An action has key, label, triggers and live. It may either route with nextMessageId (which must reference an existing message) or open an asset with assetId (which must reference an asset on the same message), but never both.
An asset has assetId, type, URL or R2 key, live and required. Asset types are image, video, audio, document and sticker.
A link references a declared URL variable and is delivered separately only when its mode is follow_up.
A WhatsApp numbered menu is generated from that message's WhatsApp actions only when actions_menu.enabled is true.
A WhatsApp override preserves delivery, template_enabled and binding.content_sid_env even when no Twilio template is currently bound.
A Telegram inline button is generated from that message's Telegram actions only when inline_buttons_enabled is true.
Every save is followed by validation; invalid catalogs are rejected without changing the persisted catalog.
Exports are generated from the saved D1 catalog, never from a bundled JSON file.
minimum_editor_workflow: Edit shared default or explicit channel override

required_api.PUT /api/catalog: replace a validated catalog during import or controlled bulk editing
required_api.PUT /api/messages/channel-override: save one validated explicit channel override
required_api.GET /api/export: produce Telegram and WhatsApp runtime records from the saved catalog

migration_sequence: Implement schema validation and the catalog API.
Import a copy of legacy messages.json into local D1.
Validate START_HERE and ONBOARDING against the invariants.
Add the Composer and media library against this API only.
Run regression tests, then deploy a preview before production cutover.
